features: Independent startup recovery layer loaded before app.js
Targeted PWA cache and Service Worker repair that preserves user data
Spotify-only authentication reset that preserves preferences and preferred device
One-shot automatic recovery on missing startup signal, script load failure or version mismatch
PKCE timestamping and cleanup of incomplete or expired OAuth state
Safe localStorage and sessionStorage access for authentication data
Network-first loading for versioned scripts, styles and manifest
known_limits: A real browser is required to validate a deliberately corrupted Service Worker end-to-end
The automatic recovery is intentionally limited to one attempt per browser session
Resetting Spotify authentication requires a new Spotify authorization
